what_to_detect: A player can activate an activated ability of an object with no controller (a card in their hand or graveyard) because they own it.
near_miss: An activated ability of a card another player owns, which the deciding player cannot activate.

what_to_detect: A player can activate an ability of an object another player controls because the object says any player may activate it.
near_miss: An ability of an object another player controls without that permission, which the deciding player cannot activate.
